name: smwmusic-crash-nitro-kart-tiny-temple
title: Crash Nitro Kart - Tiny Temple
description:
An upbeat and calm tribal theme that plays in Tiny Temple, the third track from Crash Nitro Kart and last track from the first hub, which is set in a jungle temple at night.

You can define in the .txt file which variation you want to use:
0 - Default in-game version
1 - Extended OST version (3:08, 0x0E2C)
2 - In-game version but with the addition of the drum intro from CTR Nitro-Fueled (0x0C06)

Note: ALL versions of this song are incompatible with thunder, blargg and Yoshi sound effects and the vanilla bonus end jingle.
